values.note: Quoted for a May 2027 weeknight: $49 for a water/electric site, $53-68 full hookups, patio sites to $80. KOA Rewards members save 10%.

note: KOA Journey inside Sioux Falls city limits off I-90 (exit 399 area), about 10 minutes from downtown. Gravel back-in and pull-through sites in rows, patio sites, tent sites; heated pool in summer, pickleball court, playground and dog park. Interstate road noise is mentioned in reviews. --Claude

PRICE GATE PASSES ($49 cheapest electric night, before KOA Rewards). Google 4.3 (1,055). Transient/stop-over park - long-stay tests pass. Summer peak not captured.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest real electric night $49.00 (Water/Electric Value Site, Tue May 18, 2027 quote from 2026-10-19 capture), under $50 before tax; KOA Rewards 10% would bring it to ~$44. Summer peak NOT captured: koa.com refuses direct fetch and the brief routes it to Wayback/captures only, which hold no July quote. If summer W/E runs higher the gate is still met by the shoulder night.

LONG-STAY: passes - KOA Journey sold as 'a convenient stop-over or weekend stay'; nightly booking engine with 9 site types; no nightly discouragement or minimum. KOA's generic 'Extended Stays' nav link only.
SEASON: new - Open May 1 to October 12 (2025 captures, three agree).
DISCOUNTS: good_sam false / military true are derived from the Good Sam directory; nothing on the KOA pages read about military. KOA Rewards 10% is a paid-membership discount (not written).
